headline: President Trump shared an AI-generated picture of penguins holding American flags to welcome him to Greenland, where no native penguins live.
score_reason: Pool score 3 lowered by 1: the post was made on Sunday 4 Oct 2026, before the window, and it changes no policy.
importance_line: The post changes no policy, but it touches a dispute in which Greenlandic and European officials have sharply condemned Trump's suggestions that he could use military force to take the island, and few Greenlanders favour US control, per polls; the report does not say who made the image or whether the error was intended.
summary: The Independent reports that President Donald Trump posted an AI-generated image on Truth Social on Sunday 4 Oct 2026 of penguins in red, white and blue sweaters holding American flags to welcome him to Greenland, which has no native penguins. It was the latest in a string of Greenland posts since a late-September security agreement among the United States, Denmark and Greenland that clears the way for a larger US military presence on the island.
notes: Single outlet. Post date read as Sunday 4 Oct 2026 (the report is stamped Monday 5 Oct); the event is a day before the window, hence the follow-up label and the score lowered by 1. The article does not say who made the image.
